strings.bipe_app_notification_checkup_help_xiaom: On Xiaomi, turn on autostart for Bipe in the app settings.
strings.bipe_app_notification_checkup_help_samsu: On Samsung, take Bipe off the sleeping apps list in the battery settings.
strings.bipe_app_notification_checkup_help_motor: On Motorola, set Bipe's battery use to unrestricted in the app settings.
strings.bipe_identity_change_body: %1$s's account security changed. If you did not expect this, check with them another way.
strings.bipe_identity_change_verified_body: %1$s's account is no longer verified. Check with them another way before you send messages.
strings.bipe_identity_change_help: This happens when the person signs in to Bipe on a new phone without the old one, or sets up account recovery again. It can also be someone pretending to be them. If the change is a surprise, call them or talk in person before you send money, codes or documents.
strings.bipe_forward_limit_many: Messages forwarded many times can go to only one chat at a time.
strings.bipe_gallery_empty_media: No photos or videos in this chat yet.
strings.bipe_gallery_empty_files: No files in this chat yet.
strings.bipe_app_group_member_unban_body: %1$s can join the group again with an invite.
strings.bipe_poll_history_empty: No polls in this group yet.
strings.bipe_chats_mural_footer: Your chats show as tiles of different sizes. Mentions and unread messages make a tile bigger. Bipe builds the mural on this device, and none of it leaves the device.
strings.bipe_room_upgrade_replaced: This group was replaced by a new group. New messages go there.
strings.bipe_room_upgrade_continues: Continues %1$s. Tap to see the older messages.
strings.bipe_group_privacy_join_knock: People with the link can ask to join
strings.bipe_group_privacy_history_footer: The change applies to messages sent from now on.
strings.bipe_select_delete_body: Your selected messages disappear for everyone in the chat. Messages from other people stay.
strings.bipe_select_delete_failed: Couldn't delete the messages. Try again.
strings.bipe_app_drafts_empty: No drafts. When your assistant writes one, it shows up here.
strings.bipe_app_drafts_send_failed: Couldn't send the draft. Try again.
strings.bipe_app_drafts_nothing_sent: Nothing goes out until you tap Send.
strings.bipe_privacy_assistant_send_footer: Off: your assistant only leaves drafts, and you send. On: it can send as you, and the chat shows the message came from your assistant.
strings.bipe_assistant_model_desconhecido: Where its AI runs is unknown
strings.bipe_assistant_joined: %1$s added the assistant %2$s. It reads this group's messages.
strings.bipe_assistant_admin_only: Only a group admin can add an assistant.
strings.bipe_report_category_csam_hint: Sexual photos, videos or talk involving a minor.
strings.bipe_report_category_child_safety_hint: Grooming, exploitation or danger to a child or teenager.
strings.bipe_report_category_ncii_hint: Nudity or sex of someone who did not agree to share it.
strings.bipe_report_category_threat_hint: A threat of violence against someone.
strings.bipe_report_category_takeover_hint: Someone took over another person's account and speaks as them.
strings.bipe_report_category_scam_hint: Asks for Pix, data or money with a lie.
strings.bipe_report_category_impersonation_hint: Pretends to be a person, a company or a public body.
strings.bipe_report_category_illegal_hate_hint: Racism or another hate crime under the law.
strings.bipe_report_category_spam_hint: Bulk messages you did not ask for.
strings.bipe_report_category_other_hint: Something that is not on the list.
strings.bipe_move_intro: Your account moves to another Bipe server. Your @ and your number go with it. Your contacts see a new account, and people who checked you in person need to check again.
strings.bipe_move_keeps: What moves: your @, your number and your guardians. Your seal comes back when you confirm again with Pix or gov.br.
strings.bipe_move_loses: What stays behind: messages you already sent, photos kept only on the old server and groups that only the old server keeps.
strings.bipe_move_wait: The move takes 72 hours. In that time your other devices and your guardians can cancel it.
strings.bipe_move_pending_body: Your account moves to %1$s on %2$s. Until then you can cancel.
strings.bipe_move_cancelled: Move cancelled. Your account stays where it was.
strings.bipe_move_blocked_theft: The move can't start while the account is marked as stolen.
strings.bipe_move_blocked_recent: You changed server less than 30 days ago. Try again on %1$s.
strings.bipe_move_alert_title: Someone asked to move your account to another server
strings.bipe_move_alert_body: If it wasn't you, cancel now. The move happens on %1$s.
strings.bipe_moved_notice_body: The new account is a different identity. If you checked %1$s in person, check again.
strings.bipe_moved_message_warning: This message came from the old account after the move. It no longer belongs to %1$s.
strings.bipe_moved_invite_body: Invite the new account to the group. Bipe doesn't invite on its own.
strings.bipe_operator_left_body: %1$s is no longer part of Bipe. Change server to keep your @ and your number.
strings.bipe_recovery_push_started_body: Someone started moving your account to another device. If it was not you, open Bipe and cancel.
strings.bipe_recovery_push_completed_body: Your account signed in on a new device. If it was not you, open Bipe now.
strings.bipe_os_theft_prompt_body: If someone steals your phone, the phone itself can lock the thief out. Check that this protection is on.
strings.bipe_os_theft_row_body: Your phone has its own theft protection. Bipe cannot see whether it is on.
strings.bipe_os_theft_path_ios_face_id: In the main Settings screen, tap Face ID & Passcode, then Stolen Device Protection.
strings.bipe_os_theft_path_ios_touch_id: In the main Settings screen, tap Touch ID & Passcode, then Stolen Device Protection.
strings.bipe_os_theft_path_android: In Settings, tap Google, All services and Theft protection. Turn on Theft Detection Lock and Offline Device Lock.
strings.bipe_os_theft_path_samsung: In Settings, tap Security and privacy, Lost device protection and Theft protection. Turn on Theft Detection Lock and Offline Device Lock.
strings.bipe_voice_source_body: The sender's app adds this mark, and a modified app can fake it. To know who sent it, check whether the account is verified.
strings.bipe_group_link_body: Send the link in any chat. Whoever taps it joins this group.
strings.bipe_group_link_signs_up: People without Bipe can create an account from the link, with no waitlist. The link allows up to %1$s new accounts.
strings.bipe_group_link_existing_only: For now, only people who already have Bipe can join with the link. If you verify your name, the link also lets people without Bipe create an account.
strings.bipe_group_link_service_note: To invite people who have the link, the Bipe Grupos account joins the group. It gets no group keys and reads no messages.
strings.bipe_group_link_revoke_body: People who have not joined yet cannot use this link.
strings.bipe_group_link_no_code: This phone did not keep the link. To send it again, create a new link. The old one stops working.
strings.bipe_group_link_error_access: Could not set up the link. Only group admins can create one.
strings.bipe_group_link_open_invalid: This link no longer works. Ask whoever sent it for a new one.
strings.bipe_group_link_open_history: You'll see messages sent after you join.
strings.bipe_group_link_preview_count: People in the group: %1$s. Tap to join.
strings.bipe_year_recap_reading: Reading the chats on this phone: %1$s of %2$s
strings.bipe_year_recap_on_device: Bipe did this count on this phone. Nothing leaves it until you share.
strings.bipe_year_recap_partial: This phone does not have the whole year's history, so the numbers count only what is on it.
strings.bipe_year_recap_empty: You have not sent any messages in %1$s yet.
strings.bipe_year_recap_share_note: The image shows only the numbers, with no names of people or chats.
strings.bipe_year_recap_peak_dawn: You chat most late at night
strings.bipe_year_recap_peak_morning: You chat most in the morning
strings.bipe_year_recap_peak_afternoon: You chat most in the afternoon
strings.bipe_year_recap_peak_evening: You chat most in the evening

strings.bipe_group_link_joined_push_body: Someone joined one of your groups through its link. Tap to open the group.

strings.bipe_web_recovery_history_note: To read old messages in this browser, approve it on a linked device or use your recovery key.
strings.bipe_web_history_none: This browser still needs approval. Use a linked device or your recovery key.
